description: PRD-38.3: Dashboard Builder - Workspace persistence (save/load layouts), pre-built templates, layout presets, widget configuration, and basic sharing. Transforms workspace from session-based to persistent customizable dashboard.

userStories.title: Add workspace persistence columns via migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the workspaces table extended with layout, widgets, and sharing fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Alembic migration adding to workspaces: layout JSONB DEFAULT '{"columns":12,"rowHeight":100}', layout_mode VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'grid', widgets JSONB DEFAULT '[]', description TEXT
Add is_template BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, template_category VARCHAR(50), template_icon VARCHAR(10)
Add visibility VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'private' with CHECK IN ('private','team','organization')
Add last_opened_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
Add CHECK constraint on layout_mode IN ('grid','freeform','split','focus')
Add index idx_workspaces_template on is_template WHERE is_template = TRUE
Migration runs successfully without data loss
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created 20260225_add_workspace_persistence_columns.py with 9 columns, CHECK constraints on layout_mode and visibility, partial index on is_template.

userStories.title: Create workspace_shares table via migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a table to track workspace sharing permissions between users.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Alembic migration for workspace_shares table: id UUID PK, workspace_id UUID FK workspaces ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id UUID FK users, permission VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'view'
Add CHECK constraint on permission IN ('view','edit','admin')
Add created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
Add UNIQUE constraint on (workspace_id, user_id)
Add index idx_workspace_shares_user on user_id
Migration runs successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created 20260225_create_workspace_shares.py with all columns, FK CASCADE, UNIQUE constraint, CHECK constraint, and user index.

userStories.title: Create workspace CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need REST endpoints to save, load, update, and delete workspaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend orchestrator/api/workspaces.py with CRUD endpoints
GET /api/workspaces returns user's workspaces (owned + shared) with id, name, description, layout_mode, visibility, updated_at
GET /api/workspaces/:id returns full workspace including layout and widgets array
POST /api/workspaces creates workspace from body: name, description, layout, layout_mode, widgets
PUT /api/workspaces/:id updates workspace (validates ownership or edit permission)
DELETE /api/workspaces/:id deletes workspace (validates ownership)
Updates last_opened_at on GET by id
Register router in main.py if not already
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Full CRUD already existed in workspaces.py. Verified all endpoints present and registered. No changes needed.

userStories.title: Create workspace templates API and seed data
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need template endpoints and at least 6 built-in templates.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/workspaces/templates returns template workspaces (is_template=true)
POST /api/workspaces/from-template/:id clones template into new user workspace

Seed 6 templates: Data Analysis (2x data + code + document), CRM Dashboard (email + data + workflow), DevOps Monitor (terminal + workflow + data), Content Creator (document + image + email), Research Assistant (document + memory + code), Project Manager (workflow + data + email)
Each template has name, description, icon, category, layout_mode, and widgets array
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added GET /templates and POST /from-template/{id} endpoints. Created scripts/seed_workspace_templates.py with 6 templates including widget arrays and grid positions.
